object: The Preventing and Combating Violence Against Women and Domestic Violence (Ratification of Convention) Act 2017 is an Act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. The Act ratifies the Council of Europe Convention on Preventing and Combating Violence Against Women and Domestic Violence, also known as the Istanbul Convention. The Act received Royal Assent on 27 April 2017. The Act came into force on 1 August 2022. The Act makes provision for the UK to ratify the Istanbul Convention, which aims to prevent and combat violence against women and domestic violence.
